speaker: Warlord Corvane
description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9, §5.13): Warlord Corvane answers the parley horn at Fort Aldmere's gate (world.aldmere.fort_parley). Once the herald has accepted a token (oath.crown.parley_accepted) he swears the peace: the crown's oath by parley (oath.crown.outcome parley; quest.oath_crown's resolve stage pays its 750 XP and the oath's reward), Aldmere allied and reconciled, the fort opened (its gate swings open: world.aldmere.fort_open) and its forge with it, the crown's flags struck at the toll fort. Without the herald's word he sends the giant back to her; with the gate broken he calls it into the bailey to meet the Iron Regiment (the breach path); after the battle he speaks as the outcome left him.

nodes.text: Who sounds the horn at Fort Aldmere? ...A giant. The herald has sent me no word of you. Go back to the war camp and speak with Herald Maelis - or break my gate, and the Iron Regiment will meet you in the bailey.

So the herald's rider spoke true. I am Corvane, warlord of Aldmere. You come with a token the crown can trust... Swear that you will leave the kingdom's people in peace, and Aldmere will swear its oath to you and open this fort to you.

choices.text: I swear it. Peace between the giant and the crown.

nodes.text: Then it is sworn. Open the gate! ...The fort is yours to walk in, giant, and its forge will work your iron. I will send riders to strike the crown's flags at the toll fort.
Aldmere keeps its oath. The fort's gate stands open to you, and its forge works for you.
The crown has sworn its oath to you already, giant. There is nothing left to parley over.
Aldmere is at war with you, giant. If you want this fort, break its gate - or go back to the herald and make your peace.
You broke my gate. Then come into the bailey, giant - the Iron Regiment is waiting for you.
You spared me and my men when you could have crushed us. Aldmere keeps its word: the fort's gate stands open to you and its forge is yours.
No one answers the horn. Corvane is dead, and the fort's garrison has fled its walls.
